name: openstatus
summary: Open-source status page and uptime monitoring: monitors, pages and alert channels as code, driven by CLI, API, MCP or Slack.
description: Openstatus runs synthetic checks on your websites and APIs from 28 regions and surfaces the results on branded status pages with incidents and maintenance windows. Monitors, status pages and notification channels are declared in YAML or Terraform, and a CLI, typed API, MCP server or Slack agent opens and resolves incidents. Available as managed SaaS (free plan, paid from $30/mo) or self-hosted under AGPL-3.0.
contains: 28-region checks running on Fly.io, Koyeb and Railway; parallel scheduling
monitors, status pages and notification channels declared in YAML or Terraform
CLI, typed API, MCP server with OAuth 2.1 and Slack agent for humans and agents
alerting via Slack, Discord, email, webhook, WhatsApp, SMS, PagerDuty, OpsGenie, Grafana OnCall
branded status pages with custom domains, themes, maintenance windows and subscriber notifications
free Hobby plan; Starter $30/mo, Pro $100/mo, Scale $500/mo; 2 months free yearly
self-hosting with full feature parity; AGPL-3.0, 9k+ GitHub stars
React status-page widget plus a shadcn registry (26 items)
